description: Split from fz-nml.9 site 4 (2026-11-20) when fz-nml.9 folded into fz-9x7.44.8 (two-word lane). A receive clause binding the body never reads, e.g. `<<_x::32>> -> nil` or a guard-only `<<x::32>> when x >= 0 -> nil`, is still extracted and stored in the out-slot (receive.rs:~398-419 via store_receive_value_ref, receive.rs:363). After fz-9x7.44.8 the store costs no box, but the extraction is needless work. Fix: prune unread body parameters where the clause is built; guards read subjects through the dispatch, not the out-slot. Measured on develop 4a05ae2be: 0/1000/1000 scalar boxes per 1000 steps (interp/run/build).
title: A receive clause extracts only the bindings its body reads
